title: VooPoo Argus Multi-Ohm Replacement Pods 2ml
description: Unlock richer flavour and enhanced versatility with the Voopoo Argus Multi-Ohm replacement pods. Designed to seamlessly integrate with the entire Voopoo Argus pod kit family, these 2ml cartridges represent a significant leap in coil technology. The pioneering integrated triple-coil design works alongside advanced multi-core electrode tech to ensure ultra-smooth atomisation, delivering consistently vibrant flavour and impressive longevity from your e-liquid. These premium pods are built for everyday convenience, featuring a highly practical leak-resistant top-filling structure. This allows you to quickly and cleanly replenish your e-liquid without needing to detach the pod from your device. Capable of supporting a wide multi-ohm resistance range from 0.7ohm to 1.0ohm, these pods are expertly engineered to provide a beautifully balanced mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) draw, especially when paired with 50/50 e-liquids. These pods are Compatible with VooPoo Argus G4 & G4 Mini Pod Details Voopoo Argus Multi-Ohm Pod have 0.4ohm, 0.7ohm and 1.0ohm switchable resistances. The 0.4ohm is ONLY available on the Argus G4 kit. 1.0ohm & 07.ohm we recommend using Nic Salts E-liquid 0.4ohm - We recommend using high VG (sub-ohm) E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
